commands: claude mcp add --transport http swapwallet https://swapwallet.app/mcp

notes: OAuth 2.1 with dynamic client registration (RFC 7591) and PKCE (S256); no API key or client secret.
The user signs in on SwapWallet's consent page and picks the scopes the agent gets.
Swaps, transfers and withdrawals run only after the user approves each one in Telegram.

license: MIT (repository docs and client configs); the server itself is a proprietary hosted service.

notes: Official MCP Registry name: app.swapwallet/mcp. Tool list from https://swapwallet.app/.well-known/mcp/server-card.json
